introHtml: Embroidery adds a textured, upscale finish to banners, mats, and signs that screen printing or digital printing can't match. For corporate lobbies, trade show booths, or safety signage, embroidered logos resist fading and fraying even with heavy foot traffic. Choose from polyester thread colors to match your brand guidelines, and opt for reinforced hems or grommets for easy hanging. This decoration method works especially well on felt or twill fabrics, giving your branded mats and banners a sewn-in quality that lasts for years.
